_comment: Round events (DESIGN §3.2 step 5). `effect` is a bag of deltas applied by src/politics/events.ts: resources by name, population, attitude (every rival house), gravitas (the named character), corruption, fear/trust (the active tribe), romeFavour, illness (death chance for the named character). Events with `choices` stop and ask; the player's answer carries its own effect.

events.title: Marsh fever
events.text: {name} takes a fever from the marshes.

events.title: Storm
events.text: A storm takes the roof off a store.

events.title: Merchant from the Rhine
events.text: A merchant pays well for the colony's goods.

events.title: Favourable omen
events.text: The augurs read the birds well. {name} gains standing.

events.title: Brawl in the forum
events.text: Men of the two houses come to blows.

events.title: Shared feast
events.text: The houses dine together and old quarrels cool.

events.title: Settlers
events.text: A party of veterans and their families arrive from the Rhine.

events.title: Men slip away
events.text: A dozen men have gone into the forest in the night. The prefect asks whether to hunt them down.

choices.label: Send the militia after them
choices.text: Most are dragged back. The colony is quieter, and colder.

choices.label: Let them go
choices.text: They are not pursued. Others notice how little it cost them.

events.title: A debt in Rome
events.text: The {rival} have borrowed badly and ask you to cover the shortfall. Refusing would be remembered; so would paying.

choices.label: Cover the debt (90 denarii)
choices.text: The money goes west. The {rival} are in your debt, and know it.

choices.label: Let them answer for it
choices.text: They settle it themselves, and do not forget who watched.

events.title: The augurs are uneasy
events.text: The birds flew wrong over the altar. The colony wants games to set it right.

choices.label: Hold the games (70 denarii)
choices.text: Three days of games. The gods are thanked and the crowd is loud in your favour.

choices.label: The gods can wait
choices.text: No games are held. The priests say little and the forum says a great deal.

events.title: A hostage runs
events.text: A chief's son held in the colony has broken out and been caught at the ford.

choices.label: Return him under escort
choices.text: He is delivered to his father with courtesy. The tribe marks it.

choices.label: Make an example of him
choices.text: The tribe is told what was done. They will think twice, and they will remember.

events.title: The granary is short
events.text: The tally does not match the store. Either the granary prefect is careless or someone is selling your grain.

choices.label: Open an inquiry
choices.text: The inquiry finds a clerk and embarrasses a house.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.text: The books are closed. The loss is quietly absorbed.
